name: Mailgun
label: Mailgun — Mailgun API v3
description: Mailgun via the official Mailgun API v3. Base https://{region} (api.mailgun.net US, api.eu.mailgun.net EU, api.au.mailgun.net AU). Docs: https://documentation.mailgun.com/docs/mailgun/api-reference/send/mailgun/messages/post-v3--domain-name--messages. Basic auth username is the literal api. send-email posts multipart/form-data (bodyFormat multipart) as Mailgun documents; pass attachment as the platform file list [{kind, mime_type, source, data|url, name}] (one part per item; a single ContentBlock and legacy {dataBase64|url, fileName, contentType} still accepted). Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Attachments use type file. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Mailgun operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-email"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-email | get-event | list-events | listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: first verb.

schema.label: from
schema.description: Sender. Official from. send-email. Example: Ada <ada@example.com>. Also config domain default sender when set.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Recipients, comma-separated. Official to. send-email required. Example: bob@example.com, Cary <cary@example.com>.

schema.label: attachment
schema.description: Files for send-email. Multipart part name attachment.

schema.label: event
schema.description: Event filter for get-event / list-events. Example: delivered.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size for get-event / list-events. Example: 50.

schema.label: begin
schema.description: Start RFC-2822 or Unix timestamp for list-events.

schema.label: reply_to
schema.description: Reply-To. Wired to multipart field h:Reply-To on send-email.

schema.label: o:tag
schema.description: Mailgun o:tag for send-email. Example: welcome.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-email, get-event, list-events, listen. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Mailgun private API key. HTTP Basic api:KEY. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Auth username
configurationParameters.description: Username / account id for HTTP Basic (api_user). Paired with the password secret. Mailgun EXACT value: api.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: Mailgun API host for the account's region, without scheme; substituted into baseUrl https://{region}. EXACT: api.mailgun.net (US, default) | api.eu.mailgun.net (EU) | api.au.mailgun.net (AU). A domain only works on the region it was created in. Example: api.eu.mailgun.net.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
